verdict.rationale: LobeHub's development docs name an official `@lobehub/sdk`, generated from the public OpenAPI specification, with a README covering methods, authentication and streaming. A probe confirms the OpenAPI spec is live, so the SDK has a real foundation. Only a single SDK in one ecosystem is evidenced, and its depth is unproven, so it does not fully cover the plural 'official SDKs' story. missing for 10: multiple official SDKs across languages, in-depth SDK reference docs or examples in evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: `@lobehub/sdk` is generated from OpenAPI. Follow the matching README and specification for methods, authentication, and streaming.
Use the public REST API, authentication, and parameters supported by the target deployment.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://lobehub.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
